name: watch_alerts_eval_price_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: WATCH_ALERTS_EVAL_PRICE_20261107 — price-cross watch alerts read the one shared price helper (get_price_batch, Finviz first) instead of market_quotes directly (LQ-20261107-04): a fresh Finviz quote fires even when the DB row is stale, no helper quote never falls back to market_quotes, and a stale quote still never fires.
